title: Rate recalculation job progress with durable backend snapshot truth

acceptanceCriteria.description: The backend BackfillJobSnapshot remains the only owner of job status and counters; the frontend retains and displays that DTO without calculating rate, selection, persistence, or provider truth.
Both cache-first Recalculate All and Full Live Audit show preparing, partial, terminal success, and interrupted/error states with completed, remaining, total, updated, skipped, and failed facts.

Unknown totals render an indeterminate accessible progressbar, responsive numeric labels do not overflow the tested toolbar, and 100 percent is reserved for a backend done snapshot that reached its total.

Refresh reattachment uses backend requestedBy metadata: only manual durable work restores visible operator progress, while cadence, ingest, and targeted work may refresh rows without impersonating an operator action.
Status interruption preserves the last backend counters, avoids a false 100 percent state, and gives an actionable retry message instead of silently clearing progress.

Durable backfill crash, lost-response retry, restart, concurrency, and stale-generation protections remain green; strict typecheck, production web build, all 49 source-of-truth guards, and the shipped/cancelled lockdown guard pass at the exact reviewed SHA. Later PS-439 worker-lock and health changes are independently classified and leave every PS-438 implementation path unchanged.

canonicalOwners: src/services/rates-backfill.ts BackfillJobSnapshot, durable generation reconciliation, job status, and total/processed/updated/skipped/failed counters
src/routes/rates.ts /backfill-best status and latest endpoints as thin transport for backend-owned job truth
web/src/components/Views/orders-recalculate-all-progress.ts as a display-only projection of the backend snapshot

backend job snapshots plus the shared display-only progress projection

sotBypass.details: The backend still owns rate execution, status, counters, durable generation identity, selection, and persistence. Frontend code only transports the backend DTO and formats counts, remaining work, percent, labels, and accessibility text; it cannot mint rate or job authority.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-436-sync-starvation with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: The real rate-backfill continuation and reconciliation functions resume one persisted generation through deterministic two-order chunks; a failed current chunk resumes safely and a terminal chunk cannot make an active generation appear done.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-436-sync-starvation with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: A retried continuation retains the same deterministic job identity, 101 repeated cadence wakeups coalesce into the persisted active generation, and stale first-chunk retries join the current continuation instead of creating a second active effect.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-436-sync-starvation with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: Injected never-settling and non-cooperative provider work cannot falsely acknowledge cancellation or release the shared lane; bounded recovery is requested, the original work remains fenced, and deterministic continuation safely reconciles retry after an uncertain enqueue outcome.

The pure presentation projection handles unknown totals, partial progress, complete and incomplete terminal snapshots, status errors, negative or malformed counts, and manual-request source gating without owning backend business truth.

Three Playwright scenarios render both recalculation modes through preparing, 25 percent, 100 percent, error, refresh, and cadence states. Every request is mocked, so no provider, database, label, postage, marketplace, or production mutation is possible.
A backend-identified manual generation restores toolbar progress after refresh, while an active cadence generation refreshes rows but never appears as an operator-started job.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-438-rate-recalculation-progress and npm run test:ps-438-rate-recalculation-progress:browser
evidence.proves: Injected status unavailability, backend error, and done-before-total snapshots retain the last useful facts, display retry guidance, and cannot show a false complete state.

evidence.command: npm run test:sot-guard-pack with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: All 49 mandatory source-of-truth, backend-truth, durable-worker, lifecycle, billing, authorization, and safety checks pass locally at the exact reviewed SHA with inert test-only environment values.
Backend and frontend strict TypeScript checks pass.
The production frontend bundle builds successfully with 2,979 modules transformed.
The shipped/cancelled read-only protections remain present. PS-438 changes only Awaiting Shipment recalculation progress orchestration and does not weaken isReadOnly or its consumers.

The reviewed implementation is frontend presentation, browser evidence, documentation, and offline guards only. No backend, provider, migration, label, billing, inventory, shipment, or order persistence code changed, and no live side effect was performed.

migrations.rollbackPlan: Use a reviewed forward revert of the PS-438 implementation and packet commits, then rebuild the frontend. No schema or data rollback is required, and durable backend job snapshots remain intact.

rollback.strategy: Forward-revert the PS-438 packet and implementation commits only. The previous toolbar text behavior returns without changing backend job state, rates, stored snapshots, orders, shipments, labels, billing, or inventory.

liveVerification.reason: PS-438 is a presentation-only consumer of existing backend job DTOs. Unit and browser proof use inert or fully mocked requests, and no live provider, label purchase, postage, marketplace notification, database write, or production order/shipment mutation is required for closure. Exact review target ecfb6f2f102579d7fbd3430ed4c58f649b97c73c is verified locally and is not claimed as deployed; paid CI and deployment were deliberately not invoked. Deployment health remains a separate post-push observation.
